subject.title: [Bug] Race condition in approval-classifier.ts when tokenization exceeds max tokens

question: Does private ACP security testing show any current-main path where a tool or payload is dispatched before classifyAcpToolApproval and requestPermission resolution complete?
rationale: The public report alleges an authorization bypass but does not identify a reproducible boundary, while visible current source is synchronous and fail-closed; only an ACP/security owner can safely validate the full protocol and decide whether private remediation is warranted.

options.title: Request private reproduction
options.body: Keep the issue protected while requesting a minimal payload, ACP client/server versions, max-token source, protocol trace, and evidence of unapproved execution, then test that path against current main.

options.title: Close after owner verification
options.body: Close as unsupported only if an ACP/security owner verifies the full dispatch path cannot proceed before permission resolution and no private reproduction is supplied.

recommendation.title: Request private reproduction
recommendation.body: Keep the issue protected while requesting a minimal payload, ACP client/server versions, max-token source, protocol trace, and evidence of unapproved execution, then test that path against current main.
